items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Jimmy Dorsey, Jack Teagarden. Those two stand out in my mind, those two particularly.

ctx.x: You mentioned that many of the white players would come in and sit in, and you were not afforded that same reciprocal opportunity. Did you hear Jimmy Dorsey at all?
Yeah, Jimmy Dorsey, Jack Teagarden. Those two stand out in my mind, those two particularly. There were others that I can’t think of by name at the moment.
Was there a feeling among the black musicians, any animosity because of the barriers, that this could not be a two-way street when these people came?
